entries.118ae1ec209f1e2d: A consolidated subsidiary (100% of voting rights held) with its head office in Shinagawa-ku, Tokyo, which is responsible for the HR Business. Shares were acquired in January 2026, and it was included in the scope of consolidation. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.56e4814531121ea5: This business supports corporate marketing DX, mainly starting from video. Centered on two platforms, the video distribution platform "Video Cloud" and the marketing platform "Raise," it provides solutions that use viewing data and marketing data to small and medium-sized enterprises and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥2,481 million, accounting for 89.9% of total revenue. In addition to the head office (Minato-ku, Tokyo), the sales offices in Osaka, Nagoya, Sapporo, Sendai, Fukuoka and Kanazawa are the bases of this business.
entries.6d515fc2d0ca9029: Companies seeking personnel in the driver and construction industries, among others
entries.6d7545443f331e39: DX solutions (SFA Cloud, QuickBill, F-Learning, etc.)
entries.87ac63aef729e07b: A marketing platform launched in June 2024. It can be linked with the DX solution services the company provides, and is offered to small and medium-sized enterprises as a solution to the complexity of tools and challenges in data utilization. Revenue by service is not disclosed independently.
entries.8aefcb4622cd0210: A marketing support service that uses video. It can measure and analyze in detail viewing data and behavioral data within videos, and since its full release in April 2021, the number of companies that have adopted the service exceeded 6,000 as of the end of June 2026. Revenue by service is not disclosed independently.
entries.99bfcaba08d7ed30: A consolidated subsidiary (100% of voting rights held) with its head office in Shibuya-ku, Tokyo, which is responsible for the HR Business. Shares were acquired in January 2026, and it was included in the scope of consolidation. The amount is not disclosed independently.
entries.aec7bcd05c5585c1: This business mainly engages in human resources placement. Through Alpro Co., Ltd. and Nexil Co., Ltd., which became subsidiaries in January 2026, it develops placement services mainly in mobility fields such as the driver industry and in essential worker fields such as the construction industry. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended June 2026 was ¥277 million, accounting for 10.1% of total revenue.
entries.c6c1a2912846f53e: A company that operates a DX business providing video marketing support and more for small and medium-sized enterprises, and an HR business engaged in recruitment placement.
entries.d5c67ba9e4e69441: Companies in the SMB segment, such as small and medium-sized enterprises and sole proprietors
entries.f574c763839b09d4: The company provides the sales support tool "SFA Cloud," the "QuickBill" tool that supports issuing and managing quotations and invoices, and the "F-Learning" training management tool and training content. It also provides the AI-utilizing "Fines Website AI Package," "MEO Navi" (launched April 2025), which streamlines the update management of Google Business Profile, and the "AIO Navi" AI search optimization tool (sales started March 2026), among others. Revenue by service is not disclosed independently.
